title: Storage Statements on Teardown Estimates — Repair Estimates & Appointments Desk Reference
content:
## Where it applies

A Repair Estimates & Appointments storage statement bills the storage accrued on a vehicle that stays at the center after its teardown estimate, when the owner or the insurer asks for a statement before the vehicle leaves; it is posted as one storage charge dated on the statement date. The statement covers the billed storage days from its first billed day through its last billed day, both included.

## How it is invoked

The desk posts the statement with the agent-side tool `post_storage_statement_c4ddc4f2`. The tool is unlocked first and then called by the agent with the figures already worked out; the tool itself checks no policy condition.

## Parameters

| Parameter | Meaning | Format |
|---|---|---|
| `booking_id` | Reference number of the estimate booking the storage is charged on, as returned by the estimate booking lookup | Id |
| `period_start_date` | First billed storage day of this statement | YYYY-MM-DD, calendar date in the repair center's local time zone |
| `period_end_date` | Last billed storage day of this statement, included in the period | YYYY-MM-DD, calendar date in the repair center's local time zone |
| `amount_usd` | Storage charged by this statement | USD with 2 decimal places, positive; a value with more decimals is rounded half-up to the cent when stored |

## Return

On success a new storage charge stands on the booking's estimate-stage fees, dated today, and the booking balance rises by the amount. The confirmation names the new charge reference number (an id beginning with "eev"), the booking reference number, the billed period start and end dates and the amount posted in USD with 2 decimals. Seeing that reference number means the charge was posted and now counts toward the booking's outstanding estimate-stage fees; the charge can then be paid or waived by quoting its charge reference number.

## Illustration

A hypothetical call with `booking_id` set to the booking's reference, `period_start_date` 2026-03-06, `period_end_date` 2026-03-15 and `amount_usd` 600.00 returns a confirmation naming a new storage charge for 6 March through 15 March at USD 600.00.
